「愛就是要為對方犧牲。」: "Love means sacrificing yourself for the other person."
這句話聽起來很美，卻讓很多人以為，痛苦才代表愛得夠深。: It sounds beautiful, but it leads many of us to believe that pain is proof of deep love.
真正的愛，會讓兩個人都更寬、更有力，而不是一個人一直被耗掉。: Real love makes both people wider and stronger. It doesn't keep wearing one person down.
想想最近一次，你為了某人勉強自己。那次之後，你們的關係有變得更好嗎？: Think of the last time you pushed yourself for someone. After that, did your relationship actually get better?
